description: Paraboloidal (Tschoegl) yield with the non-associated Melro et al. (2013) potential for an epoxy matrix. Elastic constants, plastic Poisson ratio and initial yield stresses follow the typical epoxy of Laheri, Hao and Gilabert (COMPLAS 2021, Table 1); the hardening knots beyond the first are a demonstration, not a fit.

units.curves: [equivalent plastic strain, yield stress in GPa]; constant beyond the last knot
